AUTHOR: Born in Bowraville NSW, Allen Gillon qualified as a
ABOUT THE
Teacher for the NSW Department Of Education in 1964, spending almost 25 years as a Primary Teacher. During that time Mr Gillon completed additional courses in musical arrangement at Sydney Conservatorium Of Music. He has written and had published a number of classroom texts, currently in use in
Australian Schools. His musical training and experience resulted in his being granted many play and drama assignments, including a huge production of
“Oliver” in the Penrith Department Region in 1977, co-ordinating 3 Primary schools, a 250 piece choir and a 13 member orchestra. Mr Gillon’s love of writing and school performances led him to write and produce many plays.
Public acceptance and the success of these plays led to the production of this publication.
